_comment: Non-secret config for the Trade Flow Excel Upload console proxy. No password here: the password is
read from the environment variable named below, falling back to the gitignored
.claude/settings.local.json 'env' block at the repo root (same value the MCP servers use).
The 'services' block is deliberately IDENTICAL across every web/*-console: each console's
proxy exposes all five services at /api/ottk/*, /api/dttk/*, /api/dealid/*, /api/tf/* and
/api/dyngw/*, so a page can reach any of them without its console being re-wired first. A
console using only some of them is normal -- an unused route costs nothing (no session is
the first call to that key).
Port 8768 keeps this server clear of ottk-dttk-console (8765), dttk-console (8766), deal-id-console (8767), inv-console (8769), tf-manage-console (8770), dyngw-v2-console (8773).
